electrical.source: RK3399 datasheet v1.8, §2.7 Power supply for IO (domain modes) + Table 3-2 Recommended operating conditions (rails) + Table 3-3 DC Characteristics
electrical.dc_note: RK3399 publishes the thresholds per IO supply mode (Table 3-3) but never states which supply rail a given pad sits on — Table 2-3 has no power-domain column, and Table 2-2 lists each group's power balls rather than its signal pads. So the three operating points are on record for the part, and binding one to this pin would be a guess.
